Container.Name: departureboard
Container.Overview: The departures dashboard for your station and bus stops in Great Britain, with its settings at /settings. For the home network only: never forward its port. Replace X.Y.Z in Repository with a release's version. Before the first start, give the appdata folder to the container's user: chown 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/departureboard and chmod 700 it. Keys go in the settings.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The dashboard at / and the settings at /settings. Home network only.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saved settings, keys, the settings password, the bus timetable and history. Must be owned by uid 10001 (chown 10001:10001).
